text: Program Description English language and literature major trains students to have firm and correct political direction, good moral cultivation, healthy psychological quality. English language and literature professional training practical thick foundation, wide caliber English talents, fluent in listening, speaking, reading, writing, translation and other practical skills, understanding of the English language, literature, and English national historical, social, cultural, political, economic and other knowledge, and has strong practical ability and wide knowledge of humanities and social science culture and preliminary scientific research ability. At the same time, in the second language and the computer aspect has certain application ability. After graduation, I can skillfully use English in teaching, translation, research and management in tourism, foreign affairs, culture, press and publication, education, scientific research and other departments. Duration 3 years
